Name: I Caught This
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Select a fish in your inventory, then press F9 (configurable) to claim credit as if you'd caught it.

This can be used as a straight-up cheat, or to work around a bug where you actually did catch it but the game lost track because of JSON Shuffle or something
